Huntington Bicycle Club Weekend Rides

Greenlawn, NY · Long Island · Road

Huntington Bicycle Club Weekend Rides is a road group ride in Greenlawn, NY. It rolls saturdays and Sundays at 8:00 am from Smith Street Lot. Pace: c, C+, B and B+ groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: c, C+, B and B+ groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @huntington_bicycle_club the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Huntington Bicycle Club Weekend Rides group ride

Several pace groups leave the Smith Street lot every weekend, all year. Weekday groups meet at Bethany Church and Breezy Park in Huntington Station. Ride sign-up on the club calendar is required.
